correctness.rationale: Liu Theorem 5.3 / Corollary 5.5 gives exact P_{p,r}(a)=[a²-(I_p(r)+1)a-(J_p(r)+1)]/p. At r=0, I=J=p−1. For each proper divisor q of composite p, choose index ≤p−2 in the arithmetic residue orbit with δ_{p,q}(i)=q−1, proving I_p(q)≤p−2. For q=1, direct formula I=ceil((p−1)/2)≤p−2. If an eventual period s had g=gcd(s,p)<p, classes r=0 and r=g meet the same s-class infinitely often, forcing incompatible constituent polynomials equal. Thus every period is a multiple of p. Direct independent membership enumeration reproduced 204 (p,a) Frobenius values for p=4,6,8,9,10,12, and checked all divisor-branch obstructions. Proof is unconditional given the read published Liu branch identity.
